chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, said: ʿUtbah narrated to me from Ibrāhīm ibn Maymūn.
He asked Abā ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام about salat in congregation on a ship, and he said: There is no harm in it.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abā ʿAbd Allāh, a title of Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.السَّفِينَةِ: ship, the location where the prayer is performed
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the ritual prayer being discussed
key_terms.جَمَاعَةٍ: congregation, meaning performing the prayer collectively
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm, indicating permissibility

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat in congregation on a ship?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling from Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام permitting salat in congregation on a ship. It indicates the flexibility of congregational worship in travel and unusual settings.
